_comment: Live probe against designated test company 6789 on 2026-08-26, resolving
project-status T-17. Sanitised: the secret key, the partner details and the
product price context are omitted; the mk_ids belonged to two probe sales
orders that were created and deleted by the same run.
The question was whether MetaKocka accepts and retains a multi-entry
mark_paid array, since the whole payment design sends the complete desired
ledger on every write and relies on replacement rather than accumulation.
It does. It also revealed that an empty array does NOT clear a payment,

observations.conclusion: A multi-entry mark_paid is accepted and both entries are retained.
Replacement, not accumulation. 150 rather than 300. This is what makes a repeated reconciliation pass a no-op.
A second capture arriving later is representable by re-sending the whole ledger.
Full replacement confirmed in both directions.
AN EMPTY ARRAY CLEARS NOTHING. It behaves exactly like omitting the key.
Absent means leave the payment alone. Confirms the update path may safely omit it.
This is how a payment is cleared. The field disappears rather than reading 0.
Accepted. Deliberately NOT used: representing a refund this way is an accounting decision this app does not get to invent.
A document can be emptied of lines, which the obsolete-document policy relies on.

getDocumentNotes: There is NO payment_list field under any name. The app's schema expected one,
so hasPayment could never be true and the ambiguous-write recovery never
recorded a payment it had in fact sent. sum_paid is the real field.
return_payment_list, show_payments and return_mark_paid all change nothing.

deleteDocument.conclusion: delete_document needs mk_id AND doc_type. Note get_document takes the same id as doc_id. The app's original { doc_id } shape could never have worked.

paymentTypeNotes: 'Prenos preplačila' was refused: opr_code 6, 'The payment instrument needs to
be tax certified, but you do not have tax cash registers activated.' Only
'Transakcijski račun' is usable in this company, which is consistent with the
earlier finding that cash/card values require fiscal cash registers.
